people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

people.name: James
people.line: Son of Zebedee, one of the Twelve Apostles

translations.web: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky, and destroy them, just as Elijah did?”
translations.bsb: When the disciples James and John saw this, they asked, “Lord, do You want us to call down fire from heaven to consume them?”
translations.kjv: And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?
translations.asv: And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, wilt thou that we bid fire to come down from heaven, and consume them?
